canonical_project: Google/Raiden Infotech AI Hub - Rambilli campus (part of Vizag gigawatt AI hub)
owner: Google via Raiden Infotech India (SPV) with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel
notes: Google broke ground 2026-04-28 on a USD 15bn gigawatt-scale AI hub spanning three campuses: Rambilli (Anakapalli; 160 acres) plus Adavivaram/Mudasarlova and Tarluvada (Visakhapatnam). Initial ~1 GW capacity, planned expansion toward 5 GW (state 4-5 GW by 2030 target). 480 acres allotted to Adani Infra across the three sites.
